Augured Homecoming

April 8, 2026
(6 months ago)
Previous Next
Luna V - Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind Luna VII - Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
  • Details
  • Update Details
  • Update Maintenance Preview
  • Version Highlights

From the moment we open our eyes, we begin to perceive the world.
We hear poetry, we hear songs — they guide the fae to the mortal realm, and people into endless time and space.
There is no need to feel sorrow for the past or the future, for this world is vast enough to swallow all melancholy.

Version "Luna VI" (or Version 6.5) of Genshin Impact, Augured Homecoming, (or Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo) was released on April 8, 2026.

Imaginarium Theater
  • Update Scheduled for May 1
    • After the Version "Luna VI" update, a new season of Imaginarium Theater will be available on May 1, 2026.
      • Required Elemental Types: Pyro, Hydro, and Dendro
      • Opening Characters: Dehya, Yanfei, Kamisato Ayato, Dahlia, Kinich, and Kirara
      • When Imaginarium Theater is open, the corresponding Opening Characters will obtain Fantastical Blessings.
      • Special Guest Stars: Varka, Razor, Albedo, and Zibai
      • After the new season of Imaginarium Theater begins, the characters Lauma, Varesa, Chevreuse, and Dahlia will each gain a new "Thespian Trick" that can be exchanged from the NPC Wolfy.
Spiral Abyss
  • Update Scheduled for April 16
    • Following the Version "Luna VI" update, a new season of Spiral Abyss will come online on April 16.
    • Floor 11 Ley Line Disorder changed to:
      • All party members have their Elemental Mastery increased by 200.
    • Floor 12 Ley Line Disorders changed to:
      • First Half: Lunar-Crystallize DMG is increased by 75%.
      • Second Half: Active characters' Normal and Charged Attack DMG is increased by 75%.
    • Updated the monster lineup on Floors 11 – 12 of the Spiral Abyss.
    • Blessing of the Abyssal Moon: Rumbling Moon
      • When "Moondrift Harmony" is triggered, a shockwave is unleashed at the character's position to deal True DMG to opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
  • Update Scheduled for May 16
    • After the Version "Luna VI" update, Phase 2 of the Spiral Abyss will be updated on May 16.
    • Floor 11 Ley Line Disorder changed to:
      • All party members receive a 75% Pyro DMG Bonus.
    • Floor 12 Ley Line Disorders changed to:
      • First Half: All party members receive a 75% Pyro DMG Bonus.
      • Second Half: Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 75%.
    • Updated the monster lineup on Floors 11 – 12 of the Spiral Abyss.
    • Blessing of the Abyssal Moon: Shield-Shattering Moon
      • While the active character is protected by a Shield, when they deal DMG to opponents, their attacks will unleash a shockwave at the opponent's position that deals True DMG. This can trigger once every 3s.
Miliastra Wonderland
  • Cosmetic Sets
    • The "Scales Aflame" Event Ode brings four new sets: "Scaleblade Chronicles," "Sleek Sprint," "Cheerful Playmate," and "Blazing Ambition."
    • Chronicles of the Realms/Epic of the Realms features 3 new sets: "Lazurite Sword," "Leisurely Wisteria," and "Evening Seabreeze."
    • Three new sets are available for a limited time only from the Miliastra Shop: "Wicked Warlock," "Resolute Spirit," and "Frosty Roar/Scorching Roar."
    • "Encounter Echoes" Standard Ode: 1 New Set Catalog, "Tart Berry Muse," along with 70 Exceptional (3-Star) Component Catalogs, have been made available.
    • Take part in the "Raiment Collection: Clear Radiance" event to obtain the new "Timeless Echo" set.
    • After the version update, the set "Owl Envoy" that was obtainable through an earlier limited-time event will be available for a limited time at the Miliastra Shop.
  • Lobby
    • With the new version update, the Public Lobby will be changed to a new theme: "Beacon Front: Scorching Flame."
    • Travelers can purchase the new Private Lobby "Beacon Front: Blazing Realm" through the Miliastra Pass.
  • Wonderlands
    • The "Special Experience" section in Wonderlands' filter menu will now include three new options: Leaderboard, Rank, and Ultimate Achievement. In addition, the "Wonderland Collection" filters have been expanded to match all categories available in the "Filter Wonderland" feature.
    • Adds the share stage button. On mobile devices, Wonderland stage links can be shared directly to other platforms, while on PC, the link can be copied to the clipboard for sharing.
  • The new version also adds additional cosmetic components, expressions, special effects, and actions, as well as optimizes certain parts of the interface layout.
  • For updates regarding the "Miliastra Wonderland" stage editor and Miliastra Sandbox, Travelers can check "My Miliastra Wonderland" > "Notices."

Adjustments & Optimizations[]

Miliastra Wonderland
  1. A new "Public Channel" has been added to Miliastra Wonderland, and Travelers can share Cosmetics, recruit teammates, and recruit in the lobby via the Public Channel.
  2. In Miliastra Wonderland, you can now initiate private chats with strangers. Press the corresponding Traveler's avatar, then press the "Chat" button to initiate.
  3. In Miliastra Wonderland, the maximum capacity of the Public Lobby has been adjusted from 20 to 40.
  4. Optimizes the filtering function in the "Search Wonderlands" interface: The "Type" option is now displayed directly on the interface, and new options have been added to the filters.
  5. Optimizes the material effects of the Cosmetic "Galaxy Wanderer Robe" (Top) while in motion.
  6. Adds an audio input setting option to Settings > Audio on mobile devices.
Serenitea Pot
  1. In the Editing Screen, when the area's load reaches a certain threshold, an indicator will appear beneath the furnishing icon, helping you quickly determine if that furnishing exceeds the load.
  2. After reaching Trust Rank 10, the crafting time for furnishings will be reduced by 4 hours, and the upper limit of the furnishing creation queue will be increased from 10 to 15.
  3. "Realm Music" now displays tracks that have not yet been obtained and indicates the regions where their Radiant Spincrystals can be found. In addition, some tracks can now be previewed in this interface.
  4. Optimizes the display of companions who prefer the selected Gift Set in the Editing Screen.
System
  1. Optimizes the "Auto Add" logic in the Character Level Up and Weapon/Artifact Enhance interfaces: When auto adding materials, the system will now take current Mora into account, preventing cases where there isn't enough Mora after materials are added.
  2. Reduces the frequency of the overflow EXP hint pop-up in the Character > Level Up screen: When the overflow EXP from leveling up is less than one "Adventurer's Experience" (i.e., 5000 EXP), the pop-up hint will no longer appear.
  3. In the "Artifact" "Lock Assistance" feature, the number of "Recommended Set Plan" for the same set will be increased, and the number of custom configurations that can be saved has been adjusted from 2 to 3.
Audio
  1. Optimizes the sound performance of the gadget "Harmonic Keys."
  2. Optimizes the sound effects in some areas of Nod-Krai, as well as the music performance in some World Quests.
  3. Optimizes the wording of some Japanese voice-over lines for the character "Varka" in the character's Profile > Voice-Over interface.
  4. Supplements English voice-over lines for updated content between Version 5.2 and Version 5.7. (The English voice-over lines for these versions are now complete with the exception of five remaining lines that will be added in future updates.)
Other
  1. Optimizes the text descriptions for certain Brilliant Blessings in Imaginarium Theater.
  2. Rainbowdrop Crystals can now be pulled by certain skills or effects.
Genius Invokation TCG Balance Adjustment
  1. Adjusts the effect of Event Card "Void Rift" for the Character Card "Skirk": Playing this card will be considered a "Combat Action" and can only be played if you have a card in your Hand that currently costs 3 Elemental Dice.
  2. Increases the starting Max HP of Barbara's Character Card from 10 to 12.
  3. Adjusts the DMG of Eula's Summon "Lightfall Sword": Physical DMG increased from 3 to 4.
  4. Adjusts the DMG of Freminet's state "Pers Timer": "...deals an additional 2 Physical DMG" has been increased to "...deals an additional 3 Physical DMG."
  5. Adjusted the effect of Arataki Itto's Summon "Ushi": It now deals 1 Geo DMG at the end phase and also grants Arataki Itto Superlative Superstrength.
  6. Adjusts the effect of the Event Card "Mystique Soup: Fury": The effect "...the next DMG dealt by the target character +2." has been adjusted to "The next DMG dealt by the target character +1. (Usage(s): 2)"
  7. Adjusts the effect of the Support Card "Tonatiuh": The effect "...draw 1 card." has been adjusted to "...draw 2 cards."

Bug Fixes[]

Quests
  1. Fixes an issue in "Travelers' Tales: Yoimiya: Like Being a Child Again" where Yoimiya could sometimes disappear abnormally.
  2. Fixes an issue whereby there are display errors in the cutscene of Varka's Story Quest "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition."
  3. Fixes an issue where characters could occasionally enter an abnormal falling state after falling off platforms in the Domain during Varka's Story Quest "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition."
  4. Fixes an issue in Durin's Story Quest "The Magic Known as Storytelling" where "Dvalin" may behave abnormally under certain circumstances.
  5. Fixes an issue where a display error may occur in the cutscene of the Story Quest "A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon."
  6. Fixes an issue where, in certain quests with special color filters, the Traveler's outfit would not change color to match the quest visuals after switching outfits.
Enemies
  1. Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "Perpetual Mechanical Array" would not split into Ruin Sentinels under certain circumstances.
  2. Fixes an issue where the "Radiant Cocoon" effect had a chance to remain on the character after challenging the enemy "Radiant Moongecko" and disengaging from combat.
  3. Fixes an issue whereby the Windsunder Arrow of the character "Venti" and the Elemental Burst of "Yumemizuki Mizuki" would target abnormally during the enemy Radiant Moongecko's "Voidstep Reverberation" skill.
  4. Fixes an issue whereby skills cast by monsters summoned by the enemy "Guardian of Apep's Oasis" could behave abnormally.
  5. Fixes an issue where the "Stoneborne Seeds" of the enemy "Crab Tsar" could be abnormally frozen by the Frozen reaction.
  6. Fixes an issue where the enemy "The Doctor" may move outside the battle area during combat and be unable to return.
  7. Fixes an issue where the wrong effect colors are shown when certain enemies are hit by "Fragrance in Thaw" Hu Tao's Elemental Burst.
  8. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, when the Deepdark Shield of "Fisher of Hidden Depths" or "Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares" took damage, there was a small chance that the DMG value would appear abnormal.
Characters
  1. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, holding on "Nightmare's Burning Heart" Illuga's Elemental Skill would abnormally trigger the Tap effect instead.
  2. Fixes an issue where the character Illuga would still deal damage to enemies for a brief period after his Charged Attack ended under specific circumstances.
  3. Fixes an issue under certain circumstances where, after the character Mona gained the "Astral Glow of Mercury" effect, it would not take effect when other characters in the party triggered Vaporize reactions.
  4. Fixes an issue whereby the collar and cape models of the character "Varka" would display abnormally and clip through other parts during certain actions.
  5. Fixes an issue whereby the character "Varka" could display abnormally after switching the weapon appearance under specific circumstances.
  6. Fixes an issue where the character "Zibai" may exhibit minor facial display anomalies at certain angles.
System
  1. Fixes an issue whereby, under specific circumstances, some interfaces would incorrectly display a hint indicating that extra rewards of Daily Commissions could be claimed before claiming all 4 commission rewards.
  2. Fixes an issue where the character "Citlali" may display abnormal expressions when switching actions in the Photo interface under certain circumstances.
  3. Fixes an issue where a line of dialogue in the Archon Quest "The Rainbow Destined to Burn" displayed incorrectly in the Travel Log.
  4. Fixes an issue where the virtual keyboard would display abnormally on some iPad devices when using a controller as the control device.
  5. Fixes an issue whereby the character "Varka" was too high in the Character > Level Up and wind glider interfaces.
Miliastra Wonderland
  1. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the "Popular Miliastra Wonderland" button would still display a red dot notification when the "Popular Miliastra Wonderland" interface could not be opened.
  2. Fixes an issue whereby characters could not pick up Jump Boosts in the lobby of Miliastra Wonderland under certain circumstances.
  3. Fixes an issue whereby certain controller buttons conflicted with each other in the "Ode" interface under specific circumstances.
  4. Fixes an issue where the Cosmetic "Healing Heart Short Hair (Hairstyle)" could display abnormally under certain circumstances.
  5. Fixes an issue whereby characters could occasionally behave abnormally after moving to certain positions in the Lobby "Festive Market: Chimes Ring in the New Year."
  6. Fixes an issue where, on certain mobile devices, the material rendering of the Cosmetic "Cloud Edge's Glory: Blazing Radiance" could occasionally display abnormally.
  7. Fixes an issue where the related interface could occasionally display abnormally when tapping on Cosmetic Plans shared by other Travelers in the Lobby chat channel.
Serenitea Pot
  1. Fixes an issue where some Furnishings are missing the "Source" display.
  2. Fixes an issue where the Furnishing "Bottoms Up" cannot be placed on a table.
Genius Invokation TCG
  1. Fixes display and text errors affecting some cards.
  2. Fixes an issue where the "Superconduct Blessing: Deep Freeze" effect from the Support Card "Elemental Transfiguration: Superconduct Blessing" would erroneously trigger multiple times.
  3. Fixes an issue where the "Duration (Rounds)" count of the Support Card "Seirai Island" in the deck may be consumed abnormally at the end of a round before it takes effect.
Audio
  1. Fixes an issue where, in the "Party Setup" screen, after selecting the character "Jahoda" and then switching to another character, the sound effect triggered with Jahoda would not be interrupted.
  2. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, some sound effects of the character "Columbina" would still play when the game sound effects volume was set to 0.
  3. Fixes an issue where the sound effect for the first hit of Varka's Normal Attack may be missing under certain circumstances.
Other
  1. Fixes an issue where some characters may display abnormally after entering the open-world puzzle object "Dew Bubbles."
  2. Fixes an issue whereby certain game scenes in "Travelers' Tales: Kuki Shinobu: The Letter of the Law" could occasionally appear abnormally.
  3. Fixes text errors in certain quests, interfaces, dialogues, and descriptions.
  4. Fixes an issue whereby some wild creatures and animals in the Serenitea Pot would occasionally exhibit abnormal behavior.
  5. Adjusts the trigger logic for certain dialogues with Neuvillette in Yilong Wharf under specific conditions, preventing the shop NPC Fengtai from being blocked by the conversation and unavailable for item purchases.
  6. Fixes an issue under certain circumstances where the NPC Uncle Gao in Liyue Harbor would disappear abnormally.
  7. Fixes an issue whereby Traveler could occasionally behave abnormally after changing outfits when interacting with Escoffier in the Serenitea Pot.
  8. Fixes some text errors in certain languages and optimizes text. (Note: Related in-game functions have not changed. Travelers can view the changes in different languages by going to the Paimon Menu > Settings > Language and changing the Game Language.)
    Text-related fixes and optimizations in English include:
    • Supplements English voice-over lines for content from Version 5.2 to Version 5.7. The English voice-over lines for these versions are now complete, with the exception of a few remaining lines for Dainsleif that will be added in future updates.
    • Optimizes certain English translations.
    • Optimizes inconsistencies between certain voice-overs and the corresponding lines.

Known Issues[]

  1. Currently, under certain circumstances, when applying filters in the Miliastra Wonderland's "Search Wonderlands" interface, there is a chance that abnormal filtering results will appear.
    Travelers who encounter this issue can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again as a temporary fix. This issue will be fixed in a future version.

Post-patch Optimization & Fixes[]

2026-04-08 21:50 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, after returning to Teyvat from the Personal Lobby in Miliastra Wonderland, there was a chance that some in-game scenes would appear abnormal.
2026-04-09 18:35 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue in the Temple of Space whereby enemy drops would be abnormal in a specific location.
2026-04-11 13:15 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, when approaching certain areas in the Temple of Space and Luyang Academy, the in-game camera position would become abnormal and characters would be unable to teleport.
    Travelers affected by this issue can select the "Leave" button in the upper-right corner of the screen and select "Leave for Now." Then log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and log in again to resolve the issue.
  2. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, certain chest(s) would disappear abnormally in the "Shooting Practice" challenge given by the NPC "Herstal" at Dornman Port.
    Travelers affected by this issue can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again. Head to the challenge area afterward and the corresponding chest(s) will appear automatically.
  3. To ensure a better gameplay experience for social deduction stages, the "Stranger Messages" feature in Miliastra Wonderland has been adjusted: While playing Miliastra Wonderland stages, messages from strangers will be temporarily hidden.
    The development team will continue to monitor this feature and further optimize it in future versions.
2026-04-14 13:25 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, game audio would abnormally stutter or cut out when using the voice feature in "Miliastra Wonderland" on mobile devices.
    Travelers who encounter this issue can resolve it by updating the game via their device's app store, or by downloading the latest installation package from the official website and installing it over the current version. Console issues will be fixed in a subsequent update.
  2. Fixes an issue in the Miliastra Wonderland Lobby whereby characters from Teyvat could trigger incorrect idle animation(s).
2026-04-16 16:15 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the Traveler's Exploration Progress at the Temple of Space was not updated in accordance with actual exploration progress in the "Temple of Space: Memory Core" interface.
  2. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the interactive button for certain "World in a Painting" gameplay in the Luyang Academy area of the Temple of Space might fail to appear and make it impossible for Travelers to complete the gameplay.
  3. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, Dex could not be commanded for drag interactions in the "Temple of Space" area, preventing certain quests and gameplay from being completed.
  4. Fixes a Japanese-language localization error in the tutorial for the "Surveying & Mapping Studies" event gameplay.
  5. Fixes certain Japanese-language localization errors and text display issues in the Story Quests, dialogue, and World Quests in the Version "Luna VI" update.
  6. Fixes an issue where the English voice-over of the Sucrose did not match her idle animation.

Travelers affected by the above issues can log out via the Paimon Menu by selecting "Exit to Login Interface" and close the game, then log in again to resolve the issue.

2026-04-23 16:15 UTC+8
  1. Updates resources related to subsequent events.
  2. Fixes an issue whereby the model for Linnea might display incorrectly on certain Android devices when the Traveler was selecting Artifacts for enhancement in the Character menu, standing near walls in the open world, or viewing the character from certain upward angles.
  3. Fixes an issue on Android devices equipped with the UNISOC T606 (or similar) SoC whereby the game might crash when the Traveler was switching to Linnea. Travelers experiencing this issue can try setting Graphics Quality to "Lowest" in the Settings menu on the login screen.
2026-04-24 18:15 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, a red notification dot would still appear in the Adventurer Handbook > Commissions interface even when there were no rewards available to claim.
2026-04-30 11:20 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue whereby certain devices with PowerVR GPUs (such as those using the Dimensity 930, Dimensity 7020, and Dimensity 7025 Ultra) could crash unexpectedly during specific quests or scenarios.
    Note: Devices with PowerVR GPUs are no longer part of the game's supported specifications. Although this update fixes the crash issue, long-term stability cannot be fully guaranteed due to hardware limitations. Issues such as frequent stuttering or crashes may still occur.
    If your device does not meet the supported specifications and you frequently experience crashes or stuttering, we recommend updating your device's system software or playing through other methods, such as Genshin Impact · Cloud.

Version 6.5.1[]

Release Date: April 13, 2026 (for Android and iOS only). No Patch Note was available and changes were undocumented.

  • There was no update maintenance session unlike Version 1.0.1.
